dice.contest: * {actor} and {target} roll against each other: {actor} [{rolled}], {target} [{against}]. {winner} wins.
dice.usage: Can't roll that. Use d6, d10, d20 or d100, for example /roll 1d20+2d6 (up to {max} dice), or a skill, for example /roll speechcraft.
dice.skill_ambiguous: "{name}" could be {list}. Write more of the name.
dice.unknown_skill: There is no skill or attribute "{name}".
dice.skill_unread: Your skills can't be read right now. Try again in a moment.
dice.use_roll_two: Use /roll2 adv <skill> or /roll2 dis <skill>, for example /roll2 adv speechcraft.
dice.too_many: Too many dice: up to {max} a roll.
dice.no_modifiers: Modifiers like +3 are not rolled yet. Use d6, d10, d20 or d100, for example /roll 1d20+2d6.
dice.unknown_set: There is no dice set "{set}". The sets: {list}.
dice.your_set: Your dice set: {set}. The sets: {list}. Pick one with /dice <set>.
dice.cmd.roll: /roll [dice or skill] - roll d6, d10, d20 or d100 for those around, for example /roll, /roll 2d6 or /roll 1d20+2d6 (up to 5 dice); with the board open, the dice land on it. /roll <skill> rolls a d20 with your bonus in a skill or attribute: Novice +0, Apprentice +1, Journeyman +2, Expert +3, Master +5
dice.cmd.roll_two: /roll2 adv|dis <skill> - two d20 with your skill bonus, keeping the higher (adv) or the lower (dis)
dice.cmd.board: /board - open or close the dice board (Home)
dice.cmd.dice: /dice [set] - show or pick your dice set
